items.title: Reality Doesn't Need Your Permission to Escalate
items.excerpt: "Let's get this to green by Friday." Not the work. The status. The work was exactly where it had been on Monday, which is to say not ready, and everyone in the room knew it. But the report was due, red items invited questions, and questions invited attention nobody wanted. So a yellow became a green, a risk got "closed," and the one engineer who kept insisting the release wasn't ready was thanked for his diligence and quietly dropped from the next invite.
